Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting to signed-in account  ### What I found from a full read-through of the code (no changes made)  I traced the entire path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → SQLite.
